c75b4df3-37b5-4b5b-84a5-17a4a4629cdb/Eve.en: This day, the sky was high and clouds pale, the air clear and wind gentle.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> was taking a break when something was fluttering in the sky.<NL>Looking up, there was a magpie circling in mid-air. After three loops, it descended directly,<NL>flying toward <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>...
c75b4df3-37b5-4b5b-84a5-17a4a4629cdb/Eve.cn: 是日，天高云淡，气朗风清，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>正稍事歇息，忽听得天上“扑棱棱”几声响，<NL>抬眼望去，只见一鸟鹊在半空盘旋，它环绕三圈，径自下落，<NL>便向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>飞来……

03a05875-348a-4f6d-b6aa-59d3258fa4f1/Eve.en: Having walked through streets and alleys paved with stone bricks and blue tiles for quite some time,<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> was thinking of finding a place to rest,<NL>when the sound of drumbeats, gong strikes, and opera singing came from the crossroad ahead.<NL>The melody and singing were so rhythmic and moving that, when the song ended, bursts of cheers followed!
03a05875-348a-4f6d-b6aa-59d3258fa4f1/Eve.cn: 石砖青瓦，长街短巷，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>行了多时，正想寻个地方歇歇脚，<NL>忽听得前面十字街口处击鼓鸣钲、敲打锣钹，传来唱戏之声。<NL>那曲调顿挫，唱段悠扬铿越、悲慨激昂，一曲唱末，便有阵阵喝彩声！

a5dfe753-e3f9-475f-86d8-92c6b2f7defd/Eve.en: The magpie flew before them, its wings beating slower as if about to fall.<NL>Only then did <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> realize this was actually a bamboo mechanical bird.<NL>Its body was smooth and round, its wings intricately carved with overlapping layers of feathers,<NL>and its eyes were black agate that sparkled with light. What a meticulously crafted object...
a5dfe753-e3f9-475f-86d8-92c6b2f7defd/Eve.cn: 鸟鹊飞至身前，鼓翼渐缓，似要坠落，<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>方才看出，这竟是一只竹制的机关鸟。<NL>只见它周身光滑圆整，翅翼刻绘细腻，覆羽层层交叠，<NL>还用黑玛瑙嵌作眼珠，莹莹生光，当真是用心精造之物……

a5dfe753-e3f9-475f-86d8-92c6b2f7defd/Opt.en: (Raise a hand to catch the bamboo magpie...)

46109ff7-0fde-4d66-9763-fb846f1be717/Eve.en: The bamboo magpie left by <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/> was exquisitely made.<NL>It was probably crafted while he was researching the ways of mechanism...<NL>Why did he start exploring this...?
46109ff7-0fde-4d66-9763-fb846f1be717/Eve.cn: <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>留下的竹鹊，质地精巧，甚为机妙<NL>想来应是他钻研机关之法时所制……<NL>不知他为何开始探究此道……
46109ff7-0fde-4d66-9763-fb846f1be717/Eve.ru: Бамбуковая сорока, оставленная <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/> был изысканно сделан.<NL>Вероятно, он был создан в то время, когда он изучал устройство механизма...<NL>Почему он начал изучать это...?

46109ff7-0fde-4d66-9763-fb846f1be717/Opt.en: (Perhaps I should find <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/> in Mount Zhanlu and learn about the cause...)
46109ff7-0fde-4d66-9763-fb846f1be717/Opt.cn: （或可去湛卢山寻得<Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>，了解其中因由……）
46109ff7-0fde-4d66-9763-fb846f1be717/Opt.ru: (Возможно, мне следует найти <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/> на горе Жанлу и узнайте о причине...)

c4885f82-4587-4722-a3c6-a64740a076e3/Eve.en: That day, while <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> was traveling and wanted to find a place to rest,<NL>suddenly, the sound of drum and gong beatings came from the crossroads ahead,<NL>along with bursts of cheers...
c4885f82-4587-4722-a3c6-a64740a076e3/Eve.cn: 是日，<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>行路之际，正欲寻个地方歇歇脚，<NL>忽听得前面十字街口处，锣钹齐奏，鼓钲和鸣，<NL>传来阵阵喝彩声……

de66c12b-0103-419c-8e35-581c91b6ebb5/Eve.en: "Well fought, Taiwu the Hero!"<NL>"Great hero <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>, hit that monster hard!"<NL><NL>A few children were still leaning over the stage, passionately cheering.<NL>The surrounding crowd shouted together, and among them, there were some particularly loud voices...
de66c12b-0103-419c-8e35-581c91b6ebb5/Eve.cn: “太吾大英雄，打得痛快！<NL>  “<Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>大英雄，揍那妖怪！”<NL><NL>戏台前仍趴着几个小童，使劲助威，<NL>周围众人一齐呼喊着，而这当中，却有人的声音格外大……

de66c12b-0103-419c-8e35-581c91b6ebb5/Opt.en: (Focus and look...) Huh, it turns out to be <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/> and <Character key=Jieyun str=Name/>...
de66c12b-0103-419c-8e35-581c91b6ebb5/Opt.cn: （定睛看去……）咦，竟是<Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>和<Character key=Jieyun str=Name/>……
de66c12b-0103-419c-8e35-581c91b6ebb5/Opt.ru: (Сосредоточься и посмотри...) Ха, оказывается, это так <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/> и <Character key=Jieyun str=Name/>...

3e6b83d9-2879-4ac4-a79d-d76f9da2de22/Eve.en: After hearing <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>'s words, the children were happy but also somewhat puzzled.<NL>They looked at each other, then gazed at <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>...
3e6b83d9-2879-4ac4-a79d-d76f9da2de22/Eve.cn: 孩童们听完<Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>的话，开心之余，似乎还有些疑惑，<NL>互相瞧瞧，又望向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>……
3e6b83d9-2879-4ac4-a79d-d76f9da2de22/Eve.ru: Выслушав <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>По его словам, дети были счастливы, но и несколько озадачены.<NL>Они посмотрели друг на друга, затем уставились на <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>...

3e6b83d9-2879-4ac4-a79d-d76f9da2de22/Opt.en: Yes! The automaton on stage will come to life. What you hope for will one day come true!
3e6b83d9-2879-4ac4-a79d-d76f9da2de22/Opt.cn: 会！台上的机关人会活过来，你们期冀的事，终会实现！
3e6b83d9-2879-4ac4-a79d-d76f9da2de22/Opt.ru: Да! Автомат на сцене оживет. То, на что вы надеетесь, однажды сбудется!

e91bf41f-3b06-4d84-9ebe-922c884c6067/Eve.en: "Fiery waves rise all the way to the sky, splashed ink covers the azure clouds.<NL>Clanging tremors shake the mountain's might, quenching ends gather water's chant.<NL>A broken spine pours remaining strength, rain-sweat soaks without a sound.<NL>The hammer falls, stars splash and scatter, burning bright through a thousand nights."<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> and <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/> went again to the Swordsmith Villa on Mount Zhanlu, ushered inside by disciples.<NL>As they approached the mountain peak, they felt a wave of heat against their faces. Several sword forges were burning with crimson flames, black smoke rising like clouds, embers scattering.<NL>The clanging and clashing of iron striking resonated continuously...
e91bf41f-3b06-4d84-9ebe-922c884c6067/Eve.cn: “炎浪欺天幕，泼墨覆青云，<NL>  锵然震山势，淬末积水吟。<NL>  折脊倾余力，雨汗浸无音，<NL>    锤落群星溅，灼燃千夜明。”<NL><NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>与<Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>再至湛卢山庄，由门人弟子接引入内，<NL>将要行至山巅，便感热浪扑面，只见数尊剑炉皆燃赤焰，黑烟腾云，余烬弥散，<NL>铛铛锵锵的打铁声撼然不断……

54a731c4-e0a0-409f-b234-759b8dfb5c44/Eve.en: Seeing <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> and <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/> arrive,<NL>The old artisans and disciples all hurriedly set down their tasks, and gathered around with smiles on their faces.<NL>Wiping stains and sweat from their faces with dirty cloths, they started inquiring how the two had been recently...<NL><NL>"Successor of Taiwu, is there any pressing matter for you to return to the Villa with <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>?"
54a731c4-e0a0-409f-b234-759b8dfb5c44/Eve.cn: 老匠人和弟子们见<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>与<Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>前来，<NL>面露喜色，赶忙放好手中活计，围拢过来，<NL>边用脏布抹拭着脸上的灰渍和汗水，边问询二人近日可好……<NL><NL>“太吾传人此番与<Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>一道回山庄，可有要事？”

54a731c4-e0a0-409f-b234-759b8dfb5c44/Opt.en: This time we are returning to the Villa for more clues on the Heaven's Mechanism...
54a731c4-e0a0-409f-b234-759b8dfb5c44/Opt.cn: 我们此番回山庄，想寻得更多有关天枢玄机的线索……
54a731c4-e0a0-409f-b234-759b8dfb5c44/Opt.ru: На этот раз мы возвращаемся на Виллу, чтобы узнать больше о Небесном механизме...

88d0e490-413b-4231-be4e-0c097405ec8d/Eve.en: The old artisans and disciples, seeing <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>'s wish to smelt and forge here,<NL>hurriedly carried carts, furnaces, casting materials, and many other many tools. They all wanted to contribute to creating the automaton...<NL><NL>The disciples asked <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/> for everything needed to prepare, then lit the furnace, started the fire, and prepared to load and melt materials.<NL>Several old artisans gathered around the stone basin, pondering what use this object had, trying to solve this puzzle...
88d0e490-413b-4231-be4e-0c097405ec8d/Eve.cn: 老匠人们和诸位弟子，见<Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>欲在此处冶铸，<NL>连忙运板车，载来铸炉，怀抱铸材，拿过诸多器具，皆想为造机关人出一份力……<NL><NL>弟子们询问<Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>需得准备什么，便起炉、燃火，预备装料熔炼，<NL>几位老匠人则围在石盆旁，忖度此物究竟有何用处，试着解开这谜团……

88d0e490-413b-4231-be4e-0c097405ec8d/Opt.en: (Unraveling the mystery of the Heaven's Mechanism will require more time for thorough exploration. Be patient...)
88d0e490-413b-4231-be4e-0c097405ec8d/Opt.cn: （勘破玄机之谜，还需更多时日好生探索，静待时机……）
88d0e490-413b-4231-be4e-0c097405ec8d/Opt.ru: (Разгадка тайны Небесного механизма потребует больше времени для тщательного изучения. Будьте терпеливы...)

a559cf7e-ab69-4235-9ef0-83f82d6e3924/Eve.en: "Waves of fire reach the heavens, like a crimson loong emerging from the sea.<NL>Even if gods and buddhas find it hard to cross, we must exert all effort to try!"<NL>"Born amidst molten fire, why fear being burned!<NL>Just forge this demon-imprisoning evil rock completely into a single sword!"<NL><NL>There was a shed in Eight Trigrams' shape set up in the marketplace.<NL>Several traveling performers hid behind colorful screens, singing and reciting while using both hands and feet<NL>to manipulate puppets over strings. This was a puppet show.<NL>A few children squatted right in front of the stage, their bodies bending on the stage's edge, watching intently...
a559cf7e-ab69-4235-9ef0-83f82d6e3924/Eve.cn: “火浪滔天，似赤龙出海，<NL>纵使神佛难渡，亦要倾力一试！”<NL>“生于熔火，又何惧焚身！<NL>便将这邪岩囚魔斩尽，铸成一剑！”<NL><NL>只见街市当中搭着一个八卦棚，<NL>几位路岐人隐在彩屏后，一面唱念，一面手脚并用，<NL>提、拨、勾、挑、拉，以线牵动木偶，演绎着一出傀儡戏。<NL>戏台最前面蹲着几位小童，扒在台边目不转睛地看着……

7f6b8d52-5742-4816-acad-6a138a8d77b8/Eve.en: "Precisely...<NL>Ou Yezi once forged me,<Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>, with the Heaven's Mechanism.<NL>And Ou Yezi also said, since we know the sky's lofty distance, we should strive to climb.<NL>Climb to a place higher than the sky. This is the 'Heaven's Mechanism' he sought.<NL><NL>I, <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>, wish to inherit Ou Yezi's aspiration,<NL>solving the mystery of the Heaven's Mechanism and figuring out the way of mechanism to create an automaton..."
7f6b8d52-5742-4816-acad-6a138a8d77b8/Eve.cn: “正是……<NL>欧祖曾用天枢玄机，铸造<Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>，<NL>欧祖亦说，既知天之高远，应奋力上爬，<NL>爬到比天还高的地方，这才是他所求的‘天枢玄机’。<NL><NL><Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>欲承欧祖之志，<NL>破解天枢玄机之谜，研究机关之法，造出一个机关人……”

7f6b8d52-5742-4816-acad-6a138a8d77b8/Opt.en: Create an automaton... What kind of automaton would you like to create, <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>?
7f6b8d52-5742-4816-acad-6a138a8d77b8/Opt.cn: 造机关人……<Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>希望造出一个怎样的机关人？
7f6b8d52-5742-4816-acad-6a138a8d77b8/Opt.ru: Создайте автомат... Какой автомат вы хотели бы создать, <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>?

7f6b8d52-5742-4816-acad-6a138a8d77b8/Opt.en: <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>, have you made any progress in exploring the way of mechanism?
7f6b8d52-5742-4816-acad-6a138a8d77b8/Opt.cn: <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>探寻机关之法，可有进展？
7f6b8d52-5742-4816-acad-6a138a8d77b8/Opt.ru: <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>, добились ли вы какого-либо прогресса в изучении этого механизма?

7f6b8d52-5742-4816-acad-6a138a8d77b8/Opt.en: Solve the mystery of the Heaven's Mechanism...

accc49db-0b76-4b8e-a2e4-285b86354cc8/Eve.en: <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/> bowed to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> and spoke:<NL><NL>"Successor of Taiwu, the Heaven's Mechanism is profound and unfathomable...<NL>I have pondered hard but cannot solve it. Therefore, I wish to return to the Villa to seek Ou Yezi's texts and find more clues...<NL><NL>Successor of Taiwu, could you accompany me back to the Swordsmith Villa and find the key to this puzzle?"
accc49db-0b76-4b8e-a2e4-285b86354cc8/Eve.cn: <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>向<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>行了一礼，开口道：<NL><NL>“太吾传人，天枢玄机，深奥莫测……<NL><Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>苦思难解，欲回山庄寻求欧祖典籍，获知更多线索……<NL><NL>太吾传人，可否同<Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>一道回铸剑山庄，寻得破解之谜……”

accc49db-0b76-4b8e-a2e4-285b86354cc8/Opt.en: (As Ou Yezi said, to solve the mystery and climb to the height beyond the sky...) The mystery needs solving. It's worthy to pay a visit.
accc49db-0b76-4b8e-a2e4-285b86354cc8/Opt.cn: （如欧祖所言，破解玄机，踏入天外之境……）此中之谜需解，可去一探究竟。
accc49db-0b76-4b8e-a2e4-285b86354cc8/Opt.ru: (Как сказал Оу Йези, разгадать тайну и подняться на высоту за пределами неба...) Эта тайна нуждается в разгадке. Это достойно того, чтобы нанести визит.

b5e04b26-adfe-40cb-9256-52895964afb6/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> was examining the object in hand<NL>when a villager approached, saying this mechanical bird was made by <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>.<NL><Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/> left this object and then departed. There should be a letter attached within this mechanism...<NL><NL>Because this mechanical bird was such a curious thing,<NL>someone in the village tried twisting its spring, wanting to see how it flipped and flew in the air.<NL>Unexpectedly, it spiraled and flew for three days until it finally landed...
b5e04b26-adfe-40cb-9256-52895964afb6/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>正端详手中之物，<NL>却见一位太吾村民走上前来，称此机关鸟为<Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>所制，<NL><Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>留下此物，托其交予太吾，这机关中应附有信件……<NL><NL>只因这机关鸟实在新奇有趣，<NL>此人便试着扭动机枢，想瞧它如何在空中翻飞，<NL>不料它竟旋飞半日，方才落下……

b5e04b26-adfe-40cb-9256-52895964afb6/Opt.en: I see... (Take the letter from the bamboo magpie...)
b5e04b26-adfe-40cb-9256-52895964afb6/Opt.cn: 原来如此……（从竹鹊中取信……）
b5e04b26-adfe-40cb-9256-52895964afb6/Opt.ru: Я понимаю... (Возьми письмо у бамбуковой сороки...)

43fd9555-8469-42d3-a72b-2a981425c6c3/Eve.en: This bamboo magpie had no claws; its feet were actually a secret compartment containing a letter.<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> immediately opened the bamboo compartment and unfolded the letter. The handwriting was childish with only a few words:<NL><NL>"Successor of Taiwu, I, <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>, have been researching the way of mechanism recently.<NL>Unable to solve its mystery, I wish to return to the Swordsmith Villa and seek Ou Yezi's texts.<NL>If you have any business for me, please come find me in the Villa..."
43fd9555-8469-42d3-a72b-2a981425c6c3/Eve.cn: 这竹鹊并无鸟爪，足部乃是一暗格，其中应有信件。<NL><Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>当即启开竹格，展信一阅，见信中笔迹稚拙，只留有寥寥几语：<NL><NL>“太吾传人，<Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>近日钻研机关之法，<NL>苦思难解，欲回铸剑山庄寻求欧祖典籍。<NL>若太吾传人有事，可来山庄相寻……”

43fd9555-8469-42d3-a72b-2a981425c6c3/Opt.en: Why did <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/> suddenly start researching the way of mechanism...?
43fd9555-8469-42d3-a72b-2a981425c6c3/Opt.cn: <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>为何突然开始钻研机关之法……？
43fd9555-8469-42d3-a72b-2a981425c6c3/Opt.ru: Почему <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/> внезапно начать исследовать способ действия механизма...?

f35f0967-50d2-40d5-99ed-f1330773e79a/Eve.en: "Thanks to you, Successor of Taiwu, for solving the mystery and creating <Character key=CharacterId str=Name/>.<NL>Only then am I able to travel the world and see all the foreign wonders..."
f35f0967-50d2-40d5-99ed-f1330773e79a/Eve.cn: “幸得太吾传人破解玄机，铸就<Character key=CharacterId str=Name/>，<NL><Character key=CharacterId str=Name/>方可游历世间，一睹四方风物……”
f35f0967-50d2-40d5-99ed-f1330773e79a/Eve.ru: "Спасибо тебе, Преемник Тайу, за то, что ты разгадал тайну и создал <Character key=CharacterId str=Name/>.<NL>Только тогда я смогу путешествовать по миру и увидеть все иностранные чудеса..."

29219c8a-0723-4854-ad20-f62cf3ca60df/Eve.en: "The world is full of interesting things, <Character key=CharacterId str=Name/> is quite curious..."
29219c8a-0723-4854-ad20-f62cf3ca60df/Eve.cn: “世间诸事有趣，<Character key=CharacterId str=Name/>颇为好奇……”
29219c8a-0723-4854-ad20-f62cf3ca60df/Eve.ru: "Мир полон интересных вещей, <Character key=CharacterId str=Name/> довольно любопытно..."

a30aafca-821a-4400-8423-44bb7b0755f7/Eve.en: "<Character key=CharacterId str=Name/> was trying to solve a martial arts puzzle,<NL>but encountered many difficulties. Fortunately, <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> offered guidance..."
a30aafca-821a-4400-8423-44bb7b0755f7/Eve.cn: “<Character key=CharacterId str=Name/>正欲破解一功法谜题，<NL>有诸多疑难之处，幸得<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>赐教……”

We have brought this loong-head furnace from the warehouse.<NL>With this sacred furnace's aid, surely it will be easier for you to solve the Heaven's Mechanism and create the automaton!<NL>If you need anything else, just tell us directly!"
3bdfa7bb-a7cf-4bc9-b5c5-847f3e67c6c6/Eve.cn: 只见众多百辟弟子和老匠人推着板车，<NL>竟将那庞然的龙头炼炉，也搬运出来……<NL><NL>“太吾传人，<Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>！老夫把这龙头炼炉，从库房里抬出来。<NL>你们用这‘神物’炼就机关人，破解天枢玄机，自是多一分把握！<NL>若还需要什么，千万莫要推辞，和我们直说便是！”

3bdfa7bb-a7cf-4bc9-b5c5-847f3e67c6c6/Opt.en: Thank you all for your gifts! ...We have returned to the Villa this time to search for texts related to solving the Heaven's Mechanism...
3bdfa7bb-a7cf-4bc9-b5c5-847f3e67c6c6/Opt.cn: 多谢诸位相赠！……此次回山庄，其实是为寻找破解天枢玄机的相关典籍……
3bdfa7bb-a7cf-4bc9-b5c5-847f3e67c6c6/Opt.ru: Спасибо вам всем за ваши подарки! ...На этот раз мы вернулись на Виллу, чтобы поискать тексты, связанные с разгадкой Небесного механизма...

c16e2cff-6556-4b81-b09b-913dcafab3a9/Eve.en: Hearing this, the old artisan frowned and pondered for a while, then slowly shook his head:<NL>"After the Heaven's Mechanism was classified as heretical arts, most of its mysteries were deleted from records, leaving only a few secrets left with greatly reduced power...<NL>As for other related texts, there are unfortunately none left in the Villa..."<NL><NL><Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/> heard this and fell silent. Those around also showed pity on their faces...
c16e2cff-6556-4b81-b09b-913dcafab3a9/Eve.cn: 老匠人听闻此话，皱眉思索，沉吟半晌，缓缓摇头道：<NL>“天枢玄机被列为妖法后，其中奥秘被大幅删减，只余残缺法门，威力大减……<NL>若说其他相关典籍，庄内确是再无留存……”<NL><NL><Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>闻言默然不语，周围人脸上亦有遗憾之色……

c16e2cff-6556-4b81-b09b-913dcafab3a9/Opt.en: If we can't find clues from texts... <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>, do you remember how you were first created?
c16e2cff-6556-4b81-b09b-913dcafab3a9/Opt.cn: 若不能从典籍中寻得线索……<Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>，你可还记得，自己最初被铸造出来的情形？
c16e2cff-6556-4b81-b09b-913dcafab3a9/Opt.ru: Если мы не сможем найти подсказки в текстах... <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>, ты помнишь, как ты был впервые создан?

feb68b5d-5b46-4468-a308-541c005febb5/Eve.en: <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/> recalled for a long time, then spoke in fragments: "Night... starlight... There was water beside me... Not ordinary water. Within the water... it seemed like a starry river... I was very, very close to all the stars..."<NL><NL>"Starry river? Close to the stars? This... could this be a dream...?" A disciple beside <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/> asked aloud.
feb68b5d-5b46-4468-a308-541c005febb5/Eve.cn: <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>回想了很久，断断续续开口道：<NL><NL>“夜晚……星光……<Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>身旁有水……并非普通的水，<NL>水中……仿佛有星河……<Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>离所有星星，都很近，很近……”<NL><NL>“星河？离星星很近？这……这莫不是梦境……”<NL><Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>身旁的弟子出声问道。

feb68b5d-5b46-4468-a308-541c005febb5/Opt.en: It does sound like a dream...

e1c9db68-ddf5-4b90-97bf-d28ff61bc1db/Eve.en: <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/> shook his head: "<Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/> cannot sleep and never dream. This was indeed my earliest memory, but <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/> don't know... where it was..."<NL><NL>The old artisan beside him suddenly looked up and said: "Speaking of a starry river... There is a flat area with an open view of Zhanyun Peak. It's said to be the best spot for stargazing in the past, where one could see a sky full of stars at night..."
e1c9db68-ddf5-4b90-97bf-d28ff61bc1db/Eve.cn: <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>摇摇头道：<NL>“<Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>无法入眠，从未有梦。<NL>这确是<Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>最初的记忆，但不知……是在何处……”<NL><NL>身旁老匠人忽抬起头，猜测道：<NL>“若说星河……湛云峰上视野开阔，地势平坦，<NL>据传过去是观星的最佳地点，夜晚可见满天星斗……”

73b6c767-1b53-4fd7-a67d-d8e4840320a7/Eve.en: "Ou Yezi's former residence was built on Zhanyun Peak...<NL>He once forged and live there alone...<NL>Legend says in his later years, Ou Yezi had a dream on an immortal pillow and flew north on the back of a crane.<NL>People from later generations built a pavilion there, enshrining Ou Yezi's immortal pillow.<NL>We often burn incense there, praying for blessing and protection...<NL><NL>The place <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/> described might be right on Zhanyun Peak.<NL>But Ou Yezi's forging site might have turned to ruins long ago over the years. I'm not sure if you can find any clue..."
73b6c767-1b53-4fd7-a67d-d8e4840320a7/Eve.cn: “湛云峰上，原为欧祖故居，<NL>他老人家曾独自在此设炉铸造，生活起居……<NL>相传欧祖晚年，在湛云峰上借仙枕得梦，驾鹤北上，<NL>后人便在此处设立仙阁，供奉欧祖仙枕，<NL>我等亦多于此燃香，以求护佑……<NL><NL><Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>所说的地方，或许就在湛云峰之上，<NL>可欧祖铸造的地方，这么多年来已为遗迹，不知能否寻得线索……”

73b6c767-1b53-4fd7-a67d-d8e4840320a7/Opt.en: This place matches <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>'s description well. We should go investigate, see if we can find some clues...
73b6c767-1b53-4fd7-a67d-d8e4840320a7/Opt.cn: 此处与<Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>所说的较为吻合，不如我们前去一探，看能否寻到线索……
73b6c767-1b53-4fd7-a67d-d8e4840320a7/Opt.ru: Это место соответствует <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>описание хорошее. Мы должны пойти на разведку, посмотреть, сможем ли мы найти какие-нибудь зацепки...

d898f811-82e6-4d76-9be9-b0607c557a1d/Eve.en: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>'s group went to Zhanyun Peak.<NL>Ascending the peak, they saw clouds and rising mist.<NL>Upon the peak stood a pavilion, alone in the wind and mist.<NL><NL>There was nothing surrounding to block the view from the peak. One could gaze faraway into the distance.<NL>Viewing from here was truly a delightful experience...
d898f811-82e6-4d76-9be9-b0607c557a1d/Eve.cn: <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>一行人前往湛云峰，<NL>登临峰顶，只见此处云霭濛濛，烟蒸霞蔚，<NL>其上矗立一仙阁，在风卷雾涌中，自是琼楼独影。<NL><NL>山峰周围全无遮碍，可极目远望，俯瞰四野，<NL>于此一观，当真抒兴骋怀……

d898f811-82e6-4d76-9be9-b0607c557a1d/Opt.en: <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>... do you remember this place?
d898f811-82e6-4d76-9be9-b0607c557a1d/Opt.ru: <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>.. ты помнишь это место?

380d57c2-1bb2-4130-bb89-2559a0c5a9ee/Eve.en: <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/> first looked around,<NL>then looked down carefully and walked toward one spot...<NL>The ground there seemed uneven, but was already covered by wind-blown earth,<NL>with only an eroded, stained stone basin protruding...
380d57c2-1bb2-4130-bb89-2559a0c5a9ee/Eve.cn: <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>观望四方，<NL>之后低头仔细看看，便向一处走去……<NL>但见那处地面似有起伏，但已被风土掩盖，<NL>只凸出来一个受到侵蚀、表面斑驳的石盆……

ea30f5b7-3b78-4f3c-ab25-f6a1e4411f3a/Eve.en: An old artisan standing beside answered:<NL>"This stone basin is a legacy from Ou Yezi...<NL>This is precisely where Ou Yezi's forge lay in the past. The underground material storage pits and processing furnaces, long unused,<NL>have been buried by wind and sand, leaving only this stone basin too difficult to move. We don't know its use and haven't dared to relocate it by force..."<NL><NL><Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/> gently tapped the stone basin, clearing the loose soil around it with both hands.<NL>This large stone basin was in the shape of a full moon, still fully intact and connected to the mountain rock...
ea30f5b7-3b78-4f3c-ab25-f6a1e4411f3a/Eve.cn: 一旁的老匠人答道：<NL>“这石盆，便是欧祖过往冶铸时的遗留之物……<NL>此处正是欧祖过去铸造的地方，地下的储料坑、加工炉等久无人用，<NL>已被风沙所掩，只留下这石盆，难以搬离，也不知作何用处，我等也未敢强行迁移……”<NL><NL><Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>轻轻敲击着石盆，双手拨开它周围的浮土，<NL>见这石盆大如满月，形状完好，竟与山岩接连……

477d966d-9e23-45b2-92ad-a138eb1f7ecc/Eve.en: "<Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>... remembers this place. Ou Yezi once forged here... The surroundings were exactly like this... But why is this stone basin here... What was its function? <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/> can't recall clearly..."
477d966d-9e23-45b2-92ad-a138eb1f7ecc/Eve.cn: “<Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>……记得此处，<NL>欧祖曾在这里冶铸……周围是这般情景……<NL>可这石盆为何在这里……究竟作何用处？<NL><Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>记不清了……”

477d966d-9e23-45b2-92ad-a138eb1f7ecc/Opt.en: So the sky full of stars <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/> described was here?
477d966d-9e23-45b2-92ad-a138eb1f7ecc/Opt.cn: 那<Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>所说的满天星斗，便是在此处？
477d966d-9e23-45b2-92ad-a138eb1f7ecc/Opt.ru: Итак, небо, полное звезд <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/> описанное было здесь?

d2dfaaf1-b4dd-4b4c-878a-dd3c2e1cb448/Eve.en: <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/> nodded and continued: "Wait until the stars appear tonight... And <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/> might know the use of this stone basin..." "Stars...? But for many years within the villa, starlight has been a rare sight..." The old artisan's face showed hesitation, as if greatly troubled...
d2dfaaf1-b4dd-4b4c-878a-dd3c2e1cb448/Eve.cn: <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>颔首，接续道：<NL>“待晚上星斗出现……<Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>或许便能知道，这石盆的用处……”<NL><NL>“星斗……？可是山庄里，已有许多年很少见到星光了……”<NL>老匠人面色迟疑，好似十分为难……

3821b725-d4a9-485f-bf6f-b8eb4d82e117/Eve.en: "I don't know the reason either...<NL>I grew up on Mount Zhanlu since childhood and have rarely seen any starlight...<NL><NL>When I was a child, I, too, had asked why we couldn't see stars.<NL>The elders told me there were countless stars in the sky in the distant past, but the blacksmiths of Mount Zhanlu had been hammering every day,<NL>and the tens of thousands of sparks had taken away the starlight from the sky.<NL>So it's difficult to see stars here today..."
3821b725-d4a9-485f-bf6f-b8eb4d82e117/Eve.cn: “老夫也不知是何缘故……<NL>老夫自小在湛卢山长大，并未见过多少星光……<NL><NL>小时候也曾问过，为何见不到星星，<NL>老人们说，过去天上本有无数颗星星，可湛庐山的铁匠们，日日锤炼，<NL>迸溅了千颗万颗星，自是将天上的星光都夺去了，<NL>直到今日，此处便难以看见星斗……”

3821b725-d4a9-485f-bf6f-b8eb4d82e117/Opt.en: How can starlight be taken away so easily? That must be a joke...
3821b725-d4a9-485f-bf6f-b8eb4d82e117/Opt.cn: 星光怎会被轻易夺走？不过是嬉笑之言罢了……
3821b725-d4a9-485f-bf6f-b8eb4d82e117/Opt.ru: Как можно так легко лишить звездного света? Это, должно быть, шутка...

3821b725-d4a9-485f-bf6f-b8eb4d82e117/Opt.en: Artisans hammer everyday, and of course there are countless sparks splashing from their hammerstrokes. Perhaps there is no need for them to look up at the stars in the sky...
3821b725-d4a9-485f-bf6f-b8eb4d82e117/Opt.cn: 匠人们每日锤炼，自有无数火星飞溅，或许也无需仰头去看天上的星星……
3821b725-d4a9-485f-bf6f-b8eb4d82e117/Opt.ru: Ремесленники каждый день бьют молотком, и, конечно же, от ударов их молотка разбрызгивается бесчисленное множество искр. Возможно, им нет необходимости смотреть на звезды в небе...

3821b725-d4a9-485f-bf6f-b8eb4d82e117/Opt.cn: 人们如此解释，倒也有趣……

3821b725-d4a9-485f-bf6f-b8eb4d82e117/Opt.en: "Oh? Sparks from hammering can take away starlight? If I strike the sunlight with my hammer, am I going to get a sun?!"
3821b725-d4a9-485f-bf6f-b8eb4d82e117/Opt.cn: 噢？锤溅出火星，竟可夺星光，若我锤凿那日光，莫不能得颗太阳？！
3821b725-d4a9-485f-bf6f-b8eb4d82e117/Opt.ru: - О? Искры от ударов молотком могут погасить звездный свет? Если я ударю своим молотком по солнечному свету, получится ли у меня солнце?!"

3821b725-d4a9-485f-bf6f-b8eb4d82e117/Opt.en: It's but a wild imagination, a fabricated tale...
3821b725-d4a9-485f-bf6f-b8eb4d82e117/Opt.cn: 人们实在是异想天开，编造出这番说辞……
3821b725-d4a9-485f-bf6f-b8eb4d82e117/Opt.ru: Это всего лишь дикое воображение, выдуманная история...

ccb93d3a-7ef0-419f-9fe1-fd8bea904b51/Eve.en: The old artisan smiled and shook his head:<NL><NL>"It is a legend from the elders'...<NL>But here starlight is indeed hard to see.<NL>Wait until tonight, Successor of Taiwu and <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>, and you will see for yourselves..."
ccb93d3a-7ef0-419f-9fe1-fd8bea904b51/Eve.cn: 老匠人笑着摇摇头道：<NL><NL>“确是老人们的传说……<NL>可在这地界，星光实在难寻，<NL>等到晚上，太吾传人和<Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>一看便知……”

ccb93d3a-7ef0-419f-9fe1-fd8bea904b51/Opt.en: Very well, we'll wait for nightfall and see if we can decipher the mystery from it... (Wait until nightfall...)
ccb93d3a-7ef0-419f-9fe1-fd8bea904b51/Opt.cn: 如此，便待夜晚降临，看是否能从其中勘破玄机……（等待夜晚……）

440fce35-1bde-45c5-99a0-d58272978dde/Eve.en: The night sky was pitch-black,<NL>with only a few extremely sparse stars emitting faint light, hard to spot unless one looked very carefully...<NL><Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>, seeing such starlight, looked up for a long while, then started fiddling with the stone basin on the ground,<NL>as if trying to connect this stone basin with the faint starlight.<NL>He pondered hard with his head lowered, but had no immediate result...
440fce35-1bde-45c5-99a0-d58272978dde/Eve.cn: 夜如漆墨，天幕黯淡，<NL>只有极为寥落的几颗星，发出幽微之光，若非十分仔细看，实难寻见…… <NL><Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>见星光如此，仰头端看了半天，之后摆弄地下石盆，<NL>好似想设法将这石盆，与那微弱星光联结起来，<NL>埋头苦思，可一时并无结果……

440fce35-1bde-45c5-99a0-d58272978dde/Opt.en: The mystery of Heaven's Mechanism probably can't be solved easily. It will take time to explore. Perhaps we can ponder while forging...
440fce35-1bde-45c5-99a0-d58272978dde/Opt.cn: 天枢玄机之谜，恐怕难以轻易解开，还需时日探寻，不如边铸造，边琢磨……
440fce35-1bde-45c5-99a0-d58272978dde/Opt.ru: Тайна Небесного механизма, вероятно, не может быть легко разгадана. На изучение потребуется время. Возможно, мы сможем поразмыслить во время ковки...

76119804-d995-4339-bcfd-30938fa37060/Eve.en: Hearing this, <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/> chuckled naively: "I, <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>, was too focused on the immediate matter. How could the mystery be deciphered without even beginning to forge... Thank you for reminding me, Successor of Taiwu..."
76119804-d995-4339-bcfd-30938fa37060/Eve.cn: <Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>闻言，憨然笑道：<NL><NL>“<Character key=Tongsheng str=Name/>方才只顾想眼前之事，<NL>还未开始冶铸，怎能寻得玄机关窍……<NL>幸得太吾传人提点……”
